key.name: helper-path
key.description: Absolute path to the orochictl helper binary. Leave empty to look next to this extension's directory.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the panel label fetches battery state, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable automatic refreshing.

key.name: show-battery-label
key.summary: Show battery percentage next to the icon
key.description: Whether the battery percentage is displayed in the top bar next to the mouse icon.

key.name: show-dpi
key.description: Whether the DPI section is shown in the menu.

key.name: show-poll
key.summary: Show polling rate in the menu
key.description: Whether the polling rate section is shown in the menu.

key.name: notify-low-battery
key.summary: Notify when the battery is low
key.description: Send a desktop notification when the mouse battery drops to or below the configured threshold.

key.name: battery-threshold
key.description: Battery percentage at which the low battery notification is sent.

key.name: dpi-presets
key.description: Semicolon separated list of DPI values, for example 800;1600;3200. Each preset is applied to both axes.

key.name: dpi
key.description: Custom DPI value configured from the preferences window.
